sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen-Image: Qwen-Image is a powerful image generation ...
sources.snippet: We are thrilled to release Qwen-Image, a 20B MMDiT image foundation model that achieves significant advances in complex text rendering and precise image editing. Experiments show strong general capabilities in both image generation and editing, with exceptional performance in text rendering, especially for Chinese.

sources.title: Qwen-Image Open Source Release! Alibaba's 20B Parameter Image ...
sources.snippet: Alibaba's Tongyi Qianwen team officially open-sources Qwen-Image, a 20B parameter MMDiT model achieving significant breakthroughs in complex text rendering and precise image editing. It ranks first in all 9 public benchmarks including GenEval and DPG, with Chinese and English text rendering reaching commercial standards.
